declaration.limits: A scripted feasibility witness under this disclosed policy, not unaided discovery, universal balance, identical future AI after cold load or enjoyment. No stock, healing, population, needs, Ward, keeper or report-selection changes. Failure remains failure.

rendered_report:
Road clerk's copy, kept beside the waking chamber.

The workshop was our stop for road preparations: fuel, musk work, and an emergency wrap. Its work note explains the preparation. The barrow store kept a bronze ward, worth the burden of bringing home. They are separate opportunities; neither binds you to the other.

The following entries give coarse map squares and displacement from this laboratory. Use M to inspect the map; travel on foot and find an approach. Square distance is not walking time.

This is an old record of former use, not a promise of present stock or safety. Roads, inhabitants and the way inside must still be discovered.

Workshop — square (75, 100); 2 east, 1 south from the recorded laboratory (73, 99). 3 coarse squares, not walking time.
A workshop once used for road preparations: fuel, musk work and a traveller's emergency wrap. Present stock and safety are unknown.

Ward store — square (68, 98); 5 west, 1 north from the recorded laboratory (73, 99). 6 coarse squares, not walking time.
A barrow store where a bronze ward was kept. Its present contents, inhabitants and safety are unknown.
preparation_note:
A stalker's musk gland dries into a pellet beside a stationary fire. Lay it within the fire's warmth and give it time.

A carried torch can light a prepared fire. The torch alone is no place to dry a gland.

Break the prepared pellet and its musk briefly disrupts nearby creatures. Use those moments to move away. The smell passes; the danger may remain.

The travel crate held one herbal dressing: a traveller's emergency wrap for a wound after withdrawal. Use it from your pack. It can restore up to twelve health, once; it does not refill.
ward_note:
The bronze ward is kept beyond the dividing wall. Its old keeper still walks there.

There are two openings. A chip of flint cast through the nearer one may turn it aside while you take the far passage. It follows the clatter until it finds nothing.

Dried stalker musk buys only a few breaths. Stone and a shut door contain the burst. Keep a way back.

The ward fills the hand that carries a torch. Choose your light before you take it up.
